_feasibility_note: Paper kiem tra kha thi voi thanh khoan/volume that (DexScreener): chi mo khi liquidity >= size * min_liquidity_mult (khong thi skipped_low_liquidity trong paper_entries.jsonl); slippage = min(size/liquidity*slippage_coef, max_slippage_pct)% tru vao gia vao va ra; leg ban > volume 5 phut / min_exit_volume_mult -> exit_constrained, cho toi da max_exit_waits vong roi thoat voi slippage toi da (exit_failed_liquidity). feasibility_enabled=false -> paper nhu cu.
_copy_exit_note: Moi lenh ban cua vi theo doi (>= min_sell_sol) -> alert wallet_sell (live copy exit); paper thoat khi vi nguon da ban cong don >= copy_exit_min_sold_frac. sell_cluster van chi tinh lenh >= min_sol_spent.
